rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING ARTICLE 202 OF THE REVISED PENAL CODE, SO AS TO INCLUDE MALES IN THE DEFINITION OF PROSTITUTION
rows.abstract: Rationale: Article 202 of the Revised Penal Code penalizes prostitutes defined as "manner who, for money or profit, habitually indluge in sexual intercourse or lascivious conduct."  > The definition ... is restrictive. Under the Article, ONLY WOMENwho habitually indulge in sexual intercourse or lascivious conduct are deemed prostitutes. However, MALES are also CAPABLE of engaging in prostitution. Proposes, therefore, to AMEND Article 202 of the Revised Penal Code by redefining this way: " Art202. Vagrants and Prostitutes - The following are vagrants: x x x  5. Prostitutes. For the purpose of this article, [women] PERSONS who, for money or profit, habitually indulge in sexual intercourse or lascivious conduct, are deemed to be prostitutess."

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING DUE COMPENSATION TO MEMBERS OF LOCAL DEVELOPMENT COUNCILS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7160, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Provides for the following --- "SECTION 116. COMPENSATION OF LOCAL DEVELOPMENT COUNCIL MEMBERS - MEMBERS OF THE LOCAL DEVELOPMENT COUNCILS SHALL RECEIVE HONORARIA, ALLOWANCES, AND SUCH OTHER EMOLUMENTS AS MAY BE AUTHORIZED BY LAW OR BARANGAY, MUNICIPAL OR CITY ORDINANCE WHICH SHALL COVER BUT SHALL NOT BE LIMITED TO PER DIEM, TRANSPORTATION AND MEAL ALLOWANCES. PROVIDED, THAT ANY PER DIEM COMPENSATION SHALL IN NO CASE BE LESS THAN ONE THOUSAND PESOS (P1,000) FOR MEMBERS F PRVINCIAL DEVELPMENT COUNCILS, SEVEN HUNDRED FIFTY PESOS (P750) FOR MEMBERS OF CITY OR MUNICIPAL DEVELOPMENT COUNCILS AND FIVE HUNDRED PESOS COUNCILS"
